about_the_game:
Download the Smasher demo and jump head-first into the game’s entire first level! You’ll tear through several arenas with varied challenges, swap between a mountain of guns and spells, and finish it all off in a brutal first-boss showdown. This isn’t a bite-size teaser – it’s a hefty slice of mayhem that lets you taste every drop of adrenaline and chaos coming in the full release.

Try all the armory in one go. Shoot, throw, pick another one. Destroy enemies with various guns from not-so-boring pistols to void cannons (what the hell even is that?!).

There is offensive, protective and supportive magic for all possible cases. Fireballs, electricity rays, void shields and flying summoned guns are just a small part of it.

The colossal Mother Drone – surrounded by a minion swarm, bristling with rocket launchers, and sporting a giant laser eye – is waiting for you. And this is just your first boss. Imagine the nightmares waiting down the line!

Eyes on the alarm as bullets fly. Blast hordes one-handed while hacking with the other. Every arena throws fresh twists your way – stay ready.

Splatter waves of bandits, corpos, droids, warlocks, and every other low-life across the walls. Don’t let their coordinated strikes, busted abilities, or sheer numbers overwhelm you.

Leap into an on-rails shooter drenched in cyber-magic. A chatty sidekick stuck in a drone shell, corporate sorcerers, and nonstop insanity await – go raise havoc in this mad world!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i3-6100/AMD Ryzen 3 1200, FX4350 and higher
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050Ti/AMD Radeon RX 470 and higher
  • VR Support: OpenXR
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i5-4590/AMD Ryzen 5 1500X and higher
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060/AMD Radeon RX 480 and higher
  • VR Support: OpenXR

short_description: An arcade VR action shooter set in a world of cyberpunk. Shoot hordes of enemies with a carousel of one-rounded guns. Cast spectacular spells. Fight badass bosses and be badass yourself. Even deflect rockets with trash can lids!
supported_languages:
English*, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian*, Japanese
*languages with full audio support
